title: Dog Groomer Flow - Safer Intake to Rebook
description: A managed dog-grooming workflow with allergy checks and schedule fit.
headline: Know the pet before the appointment owns your day.
subheadline: Collect coat, behavior, allergy, and accommodation details before quoting - then match the right duration, groomer, and follow-up.
buyer_signal: Groomers screen pet risk and job duration through messages, then manually squeeze uncertain appointments into the calendar.
outcome: Every appointment starts with a reviewed pet brief and realistic slot.
before: Breed, coat, behavior, and allergy details arrive late, making prices, durations, and staffing unreliable.
after: A reviewed pet brief becomes an approved quote, external deposit receipt, correctly buffered slot, and rebook task.

steps.name: Pet intake
steps.detail: Collect breed, weight, coat, behavior, allergies, and needs.

steps.name: Quote + waiver
steps.detail: Approve suitability, duration, price, and policy.

steps.name: Deposit
steps.detail: Stage the payment handoff without a live charge.

steps.name: Schedule
steps.detail: Match groomer skill, duration, and cleanup buffer.

steps.name: Rebook
steps.detail: Queue coat care and the right return interval.

benefits.title: Surface risk early
benefits.detail: Allergy, behavior, and accommodation flags reach a groomer before confirmation.

benefits.title: Schedule true duration
benefits.detail: The approved service brief drives the event type and buffer.

benefits.title: Build repeat visits
benefits.detail: Every completed appointment creates a deliberate rebook task.

faq.question: Does the workflow decide whether a dog is safe to groom?
faq.answer: No. A groomer reviews every risk flag and decides suitability or escalation.

faq.question: Is veterinary advice included?
faq.answer: No. The workflow records owner-provided information and routes concerns to the shop's approved process.

faq.question: Does this charge a deposit?
faq.answer: No. The Stripe preset is disabled and no API call is allowed.

faq.question: Can durations vary by coat and service?
faq.answer: Yes. Approved duration rules can propose an event type for groomer review.
